import json,subprocess
p=Path.cwd();r=Path(json.loads((p/'PINS.json').read_text())['mathlib_source'])
print(subprocess.run(['rg','-n','map_inj|mem_map|map_mk|map_map|map_id|map_equiv','Mathlib/Data/Sym/Sym2.lean'],cwd=r,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout[:6000])
